plugins.name: indicador-de-contexto
plugins.description: Watches the chat's context size: shows it from 200k; at 250k asks the model to propose splitting the rest of the work at the next transition point if something big and separable is left; at 400k, to propose a focused /compact, a new chat or carrying on. Each warning fires once per level and resets after /compact. /foco-compact hands you the compact text.
